title: Second, Third
paragraphs: “The demi-human hunts existed in the previous worlds too, didn’t they? This doesn’t match up with what you’re saying.”
“It is true that they existed in both the first world and the worlds up until now.”
“So, in other words, killing the king ended up accelerating the frequency of those hunts?”
“Just how rotten can they get?”
Ren looks completely exasperated. I feel the same. How should I put it…? I can tell things are taking a turn for the worse.
“We attempted to return as soon as possible, but we were repeatedly ambushed. As a result, we were unable to make it back to the country and were forced into exile…”
“Ah, so that’s why Takt’s sister called Melty-chan a ‘lost child’?”
A lost child because she was exiled. What a simple-minded naming sense. Technically, it must have been translated that way for us to hear it like that.

“Currently, the upper echelons of Melromarc are working to oust me and establish a new queen. I have been resisting as much as possible, taking action with the support of Faubrey, but even the military has been taken over. That has made it difficult for me to act, and we are now at a standstill.”
“So the Queen wants to resolve this matter as peacefully as possible if she can, correct?”
The Queen nodded in response to Father’s words.
“In situations like this, lineage and bloodlines are important, but does the Queen have any other relatives?”
“Well, since it’s a royal family, there must be, right?”
After Itsuki asked, Ren responded as if it were obvious.

Was there ever such a person in the previous worlds? At that moment, I recalled the words of the Pope we fought in the first world. It was right after the Crimson Swine shouted something at him. ‘Oh no, this has already been decided on our end. Rest assured, Princess Malty. We have already prepared someone to succeed the kingdom in your place. It is all as God has guided us.’ That’s right, that’s what he said. I see. So because we killed the Crimson Swine and Trash, they are now trying to place someone from the royal bloodline who is under the influence of the Three Heroes Church as the new queen.

“Yes. One of my relatives was engaged to someone connected to the Three Heroes Church… The one currently impersonating Aultcray is working with the Pope to hasten the coronation of the new queen. According to my spies, she rarely participates in official duties and is essentially just a figurehead living inside the castle.”
“I see. Motoyasu-san once said that even if a church is gone, the religion itself will still survive.”
“Just how much more of a mess can this get?”
Itsuki and Ren both spoke in disbelief. They are absolutely right.
“The acceleration of demi-human discrimination is also due to the Three Heroes Church running rampant after seizing power…”
“They’re spreading information throughout the country to time the Queen’s replacement, huh?”
“At this rate, they’re trying to surround the country entirely with their own faction, aren’t they?”
“Wait…”
Father interrupted Ren and Itsuki’s questions and turned to ask the Queen.
“You just mentioned the Pope, right? I thought he died when Motoyasu burned down the church, but… was he alive?”
What unbelievable luck. This is a good opportunity. Shall I finally kill him for good this time?
“No.”
Oh? The Queen shook her head.
What does she mean by “no”?
“When you heroes burned down the church, the Pope and the Three Heroes Church members inside perished. However… the High Priest has now ascended to the position of Pope.”

…Incredible. Father’s words from the previous time vividly resurfaced in my mind. ‘Seriously though, Motoyasu-kun, you can be pretty extreme, so be careful with your actions. You should absolutely avoid thinking that destroying a country or a religion will get rid of conflict. That will never work. No matter what organization it is, just cutting off the head won’t stop the remnants from running wild—just like what happened with Takt. At worst, it’ll just end with the leader being replaced.’ Father had warned me about this very thing. I had only listened to him on a surface level. When we killed Trash, a body double appeared and ran amok. When we killed the Pope, a new Pope took his place. Because of that, we misread the enemy’s movements. Everything unfolded exactly as Father had said.
“What’s wrong, Motoyasu?”
“I’m just shocked because exactly what Father warned me about happened.”
I explained what had happened to Father and the others.
“I heard that the Spear Hero came from the future. Thanks to that, the bond between the heroes has strengthened…” the Queen responded quietly.
Éclair gave a slight bow. I had almost forgotten about her since she barely spoke.
Fiancée… looks like she has something she wants to say. Father and the others seem exasperated.
“If you were warned, then stay on guard!”
“Exactly! Why did you resort to violence so easily despite being told all of that?”
“I honestly thought that if I went this far, it would be fine!”

“Listen, Motoyasu-kun… I won’t go as far as calling it the ‘historical inertia’ you see in fiction, but organizations don’t just collapse the moment you cut off the head. Hypothetically speaking, okay? I don’t know if it’s the same in your world, but if you assassinated the president of a certain country across the Pacific, would that country just disappear?”
“It wouldn’t.”
Even I know that much. The assassination of a president is a well-known incident. I’ve seen it mentioned in world history textbooks multiple times.
“It’s the same thing. Sure, there might be small differences, but just cutting off the head means another one will grow right back.”
“It’s actually taken a completely bad turn, hasn’t it?”

“That’s how it is. Right now, the country of Melromarc is completely surrounded. It’s only a matter of time before the other nations gather to annihilate our country, which has gone out of control. I tried to do something about it, but…”

This is something to reflect on. In the previous loop, killing that pig didn’t cause any problems at all, so I thought it would be fine this time too. I’ll still kill the pig next time as well, but it seems keeping Trash alive is the better choice. As for the Pope… I’ll deal with him when the time is right. I should probably get Father and the others to give me some advice.
“I understand. So, what should we do?”

“Originally, I had considered requesting the aid of the Whip Hero… no, the former Whip Hero. However, I put it on hold when I heard that the heroes were coming to Faubrey. The reason being, despite our country’s hostility, you heroes have taken actions for the sake of the world. I thought that, at the very least, you would be willing to listen.”
I feel like Father and the others are subtly glaring at me. Ah, I see. This is my punishment for acting recklessly. I’ll accept it without complaint.
“There’s still the matter with Gaelion, but this is basically a complete detour.”
“That said, we were able to save Imiya-chan, so…”
“Sigh… If that Takt had been the one to save Melromarc, who knows what would’ve happened.”
Father and the others turned their eyes to Fiancée. Then, Ren spoke up.
“Would the Queen have ended up in his harem too?”
“If that had happened, then when we arrived in Faubrey…”
“Uh… g-good for you, M-Melty-chan!”
“Huh…?”
Oh? Was Father worried that Fiancée might have ended up in Takt’s harem? That’s impossible. There’s no way someone chosen as Filo-tan’s Fiancée would ever be swayed by that Takt.
“Father, there’s no way Fiancée would ever fall for Takt.”
Yes, she might cheat on Father, but she’d never fall for Takt.
“Why are you so sure? Takt is actually strong, and he’s kind to girls, right?”
“Fiancée loves Filolials so much that she competes with me over them… but in Takt’s harem, there’s the Dragon Emperor and a Griffin, who both despise Filolials.”
“…Somehow, that explanation makes more sense than anything else I’ve heard so far.”
“I heard she got along with Yuki-san and the others at an incredible speed.”
“Could he be even better at it than Motoyasu?”
Fiancée tilted her head in confusion. What is she wondering about? To instantly get along with the noble Filolials—that is solid proof of trustworthiness.
“Melty, what we’re saying is… there might have been a marriage proposal for you and the Whip Hero.”
When the Queen explained, Fiancée made a blatant expression of disgust.
“Mother, that would never happen. I’ve always wanted to stay far away from that Whip Hero.”
“I see. Just in case, tell me your reasons.”

“First, his obsession with levels. Then, the way he treats women like accessories, surrounding himself with them. Also, his attitude when talking to people feels completely fake. On top of that, the fact that he once had a friendly relationship with my sister makes him untrustworthy. And while keeping dragons and griffins as companions is a personal preference, the way he treats Filolials as inferior creatures is something I could never accept. And most importantly… every single thing about his behavior is just physically repulsive to me.”

That was a very passionate and strong statement. Just how much does she hate him? Well, she probably analyzed Takt’s personality in great detail. If asked for more specifics, I’m sure she could list plenty more reasons. Father, the Queen, and the others listened to her words with expressions of surprise.
